notes.title: New Update Available - Version 1.0.017
notes.content: Boardwalk Carnival Game continues moving forward, now featuring four mini-games for you to test your skills, and new in-game prizes to win, all while building and running your dream carnival. We have also added game controller support, with the ability to switch between mouse and game controller as you play. Simply press mouse button 1 or game controller button 1 to switch between the control modes.

notes.title: Update Available
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce the release of our first update to Boardwalk Carnival Game.

This update fixes a character AI bug where the character animations failed to trigger properly when launching a saved game.

We also adjusted and optimized several graphics including brand new tree sprites and adjusted buildings.

notes.title: Development Update - New MiniGame Added
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce the addition of another minigame, Duck Gallery.
Try to knock down the rubber ducks with a water gun. Sounds easy, right? Well for extra challenge, the ducks are on moving conveyor belts.

As with the other mini games, you can earn points toward the further development of your carnival.

notes.title: Development Update - New Minigames Added
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce the addition of the first two minigames in Boardwalk Carnival, Guess Game and Ring the Bell.

Play the new minigames to earn points which help further your progress and upgrade your carnival with new attractions. Multiply your points with consecutive wins.

In Guess Game, gumballs are poured into a jar as the player watches. When all the gumballs are finished pouring in, the player has to guess correctly how many gumballs are in the jar.

In Ring the Bell, the user has to hit a lever with a mallet to send a ringer up a rail on the tower with the goal of hitting it hard enough to ring the bell at the top.

Thank you for your interest in Beach Carnival Game, and we hope you enjoy playing it as much as we have enjoyed making it.
